1970.notes: City Code sec. 3A-2-33(a): occupational license fee of 1% of gross receipts and compensation for work in the city on and after December 1, 1970 (Ord. 97-184). The tax applied only to December 1970; recorded as the year-end rate, so earnings from January to November 1970 are overstated by it.
